description: A Node.js script for checking dependencies and verifying project structure in a TypeScript-based project, including dependency resolution, import validation, and version mismatch detection.

methods.name: checkDeps
methods.description: Main async function to check dependencies across multiple project packages and verify version consistency.

methods.name: innerCheckDeps
methods.description: Per-package dependency analysis, including TypeScript source parsing, import validation, and dependency declaration checks.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Recursive AST visitor to analyze import declarations and dependencies within source files.

methods.name: calculateDeps
methods.description: Calculates dependencies for a given file based on DEPS.list files and cached dependency data.

methods.name: allowImport
methods.description: Determines if an import is permitted based on project dependency rules.

methods.name: allowExternalImport
methods.description: Checks if an external import is allowed based on peer dependencies and project dependencies.

methods.name: listAllFiles
methods.description: Recursively lists all files in a directory.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if a given path is a directory.
